name: MyLogoQR - Branded QR Code Studio
short_description: Create beautiful branded QR codes with custom colors for links, Wi-Fi, contacts, and WhatsApp.
long_description: MyLogoQR brings professional QR code design directly into ChatGPT. Generate high-resolution, custom-styled QR codes for websites, secure Wi-Fi access (scan to connect), digital vCard business cards, and direct WhatsApp chats with instant color customization and downloadable SVG and PNG formats.
example_prompts: Create a custom emerald-green QR code for my website https://mybusiness.com
Generate a Wi-Fi QR code so guests can easily connect to my HomeNet
Make a digital vCard QR code with my contact info and phone number
Generate a WhatsApp QR code with a pre-filled message for customer support
